User Story: As a user, I want to sign in with email and password, so that I can access my account
Expected Behaviour: Page mounts SignInForm component. Form validates email+password, calls signIn() from useAuth. On success: redirects to dashboard or ?redirect param. On error: displays inline error message.

User Story: As a new user, I want to create an account with email+password+name, so that I can start studying
Expected Behaviour: Page renders sign-up form with name/email/password fields. Validates minLength 8 password. Calls signUp(email,password,name) from useAuth. Supports ?ref referral code via POST /api/referral/claim. Shows Google OAuth as alternative.

User Story: As a user, I want to sign in/up with Google, so that I can skip password entry
Expected Behaviour: Google button calls signInWithGoogle() on sign-in and sign-up pages. Redirects to Google OAuth flow. On success: navigates to dashboard or redirect param.

User Story: As a new user, I want to verify my email address, so that I can activate my account
Expected Behaviour: Page reads userId+secret from searchParams. Automatically fires POST /api/auth/verify-email on mount. Shows success state with SparklesIcon or error message. Invalidates react-query cache on success.

User Story: As a user, I want to request a password reset email, so that I can regain access
Expected Behaviour: Form collects email, POST /api/auth/forgot-password. On submit: always shows success state (no user enumeration). Shows check-email state with SparklesIcon. Links back to sign-in.

User Story: As a user, I want to set a new password using a reset link, so that I can regain access
Expected Behaviour: Page reads userId+secret from searchParams. Shows error if missing. Form collects new password + confirm. Validates match + minLength 8. POST /api/auth/reset-password. On success: auto-redirects to /auth/sign-in after 2s timeout. Shows error messages inline.

User Story: As a visitor, I want to see the Lumni marketing homepage, so that I can learn about the app
Expected Behaviour: Server component renders HomeContent + SiteFooter with SEO metadata (title, description, openGraph, JSON-LD structured data for WebApplication + EducationalAudience).

User Story: As a student, I want to navigate dashboard tabs (Today/Progress/Exams/etc.), so that I can see different views
Expected Behaviour: DashboardClient renders TabNav with tab values. Active tab state managed via useState. Dynamic content switching per tab.

User Story: As a student, I want to start a quick quiz from dashboard, so that I can practice without navigating to /quiz
Expected Behaviour: handleStartQuiz calls trackQuizStart, then uses startViewTransition to set quizActive=true. Renders QuizView inline on dashboard.

User Story: As a student, I want to see my focus items for today, so that I know what to study next
Expected Behaviour: Dashboard content renders TodayFocusCard with today's tasks, animated progress bar.

User Story: As a student, I want to see my study streak, so that I stay motivated to study daily
Expected Behaviour: StreakCard displays current streak count with animated progress. Uses useGamification to get currentStreak. tabular-nums for numbers.

User Story: As a student, I want to do a daily 5-question challenge, so that I can earn bonus XP
Expected Behaviour: DailyBoltOverlay shows DailyBolt UI. 5 questions. On finish: BoltCelebration with staggered entrance + pulsing glow. 'Practice more' button navigates to /quiz.

User Story: As a student, I want to search across all my content from the dashboard, so that I can quickly find what I need
Expected Behaviour: SearchWidget renders on dashboard. Opens inline search overlay. Filters across Dexie tables (questions, wrongAnswers, flashcards, notes) via chunked-search.

User Story: As a student, I want to see my XP, level, achievements and reward chests, so that I feel rewarded for studying
Expected Behaviour: useGamification hook provides isLoaded, addXp, updateStreak, checkAndUnlockAchievements, checkForRewardChests, currentStreak, levelInfo, totalQuestionsAnswered. Dashboard displays these.

User Story: System: after a quiz, I want wrong answers recorded and flashcards created, so that the student can review mistakes
Expected Behaviour: processQuizResult function called after quiz completion. Adds wrong answers to journal. Creates SM-2 flashcards for wrong answers. Updates competency tracking.

User Story: As a student, I want to see a personalised suggestion of what to study next, so that I make efficient use of study time
Expected Behaviour: Dashboard shows a suggestion card: time-of-day-aware, weakest-topic-first, 24h-dismiss cooldown. Includes TopicGraph mini-graph.

User Story: As a student, I want to see a knowledge graph of topic dependencies, so that I understand prerequisite relationships
Expected Behaviour: LearningMapCard renders SVG topic graph with prerequisite/core/advanced rows. Data from GET /api/engine/knowledge-graph via react-query.

User Story: As a student, I want to browse and filter available exams, so that I can find exams to practice
Expected Behaviour: ExamsBrowse component lists exam papers with filters. Links to /exam/[id] for each.

User Story: As a student, I want to start a quiz on a specific subject, so that I can practice that subject
Expected Behaviour: QuizClient reads ?subject from searchParams. Passes to QuizView component. Creates questions via QuestionEngine API. Shows question cards sequentially.

User Story: As a student, I want to generate a quiz on a specific topic, so that I can focus on weak areas
Expected Behaviour: QuizClient reads ?topic param. Weakest topic auto-selected when none specified via cross-topic awareness in competency mapper.

User Story: As a student, I want to attempt past exam paper questions, so that I can practice exam-style questions
Expected Behaviour: QuizClient reads ?pastPaperMode=true. Switches to exam-style question format and scoring.

User Story: As a student, I want to take a quiz from a downloaded offline pack, so that I can study without internet
Expected Behaviour: QuizClient reads ?packId param. Loads questions from sessionStorage. No AI generation needed.

User Story: As a student, I want to answer multiple-choice questions by selecting an option, so that I can test my knowledge
Expected Behaviour: QuestionCardInput renders MCQ options grid with animations + TTS. Click selects answer. Animated feedback on correctness.

User Story: As a student, I want to show my working for calculation questions, so that I can get partial credit
Expected Behaviour: Calculation question type shows a textarea for working steps. aria-expanded + aria-controls on toggle.

User Story: As a student, I want to get a hint for a question I'm stuck on, so that I can make progress without seeing the full answer
Expected Behaviour: Hint button calls POST /api/engine/hint. Displays hint text in QuestionCardFeedback.

User Story: As a student, I want to see web sources used to generate a question, so that I can verify the information
Expected Behaviour: SourceAttributionPill renders on QuestionCardFeedback. Shows up to 2 sources with +N more. Truncated with aria-label. Uses CheckmarkCircle01Icon.

User Story: As a student, I want my quiz answers graded, so that I know my score
Expected Behaviour: POST /api/engine/grade called per question. Returns GradingResult with score and feedback.

User Story: As a student, I want to see my quiz results, so that I can review my performance
Expected Behaviour: QuizResultsCard shows score summary (correct/total, percentage, elapsed time). Per-question expand/collapse review. VerifiedByPill for sources.

User Story: As a student, I want to review and practice questions I got wrong, so that I can learn from my mistakes
Expected Behaviour: After quiz results, 'Practice these topics' button links to /quiz?subject=X&topic=Y&count=10. Wrong answers also create SM-2 flashcards.

User Story: As a student, I want to take a quiz full-screen without navigation, so that I can focus completely
Expected Behaviour: QuizView sets immersive mode via useImmersiveMode when session is active. Nav bars hidden. Exit button pill top-right.

User Story: As a student, I want to bookmark a question during a quiz, so that I can review it later
Expected Behaviour: Bookmark button on each question card. Saves to Dexie bookmarks table.

User Story: As a student, I want to browse past exam papers by subject, so that I can choose one to practice
Expected Behaviour: SubjectSelect dropdown. Fetches papers from /api/exams. Displays paper cards with subject, year, period, marks. Links to /exam/[id].

User Story: As a student, I want to start an exam in practice/timed/mock mode, so that I can simulate exam conditions
Expected Behaviour: ExamSessionWithResume reads ?mode param (practice|timed|mock). Creates/loads exam session. Shows questions with timer if timed/mock.

User Story: As a student, I want to answer questions during an exam session, so that I can complete the paper
Expected Behaviour: Question cards displayed sequentially. MCQ, short-answer, calculation types available. Progress indicator.

User Story: As a student, I want to submit my completed exam and see my score, so that I can assess my performance
Expected Behaviour: On submission: graded via API. Score displayed with breakdown. Per-question expand/collapse review.

User Story: As a student, I want my exam performance tracked per section, so that I can see which sections I need to improve
Expected Behaviour: trackQuestionResult called per question. Competency key extended to topicId:paperId for per-paper split.

User Story: As an admin, I want to upload JSON question files, so that I can add questions to the database
Expected Behaviour: UploadButton using UploadThing endpoint qaUploader. On upload: auto-detects subject from filename. Triggers sync to Appwrite. Shows sync status. Seed database button also available.

User Story: As a student, I want to start a flashcard session by subject, so that I can review flashcards
Expected Behaviour: FlashcardsClient shows subject selector, source picker (ai|mistakes|vocabulary). On start: loads deck cards via flashcardEngine.

User Story: As a student, I want to generate flashcards from my study material, so that I can create study aids quickly
Expected Behaviour: source='ai': generates questions/answers via QuestionEngine. Creates SM-2 cards.

User Story: As a student, I want to review flashcards created from my wrong answers, so that I can learn from mistakes
Expected Behaviour: source='mistakes': loads wrong-answer journal as flashcard session. Cards created during quiz result processing.

User Story: As a student, I want to swipe through flashcards like Tinder, so that studying feels more engaging
Expected Behaviour: SwipeableCardDeck renders 3-card cascade with framer-motion drag='x'. Colored overlay feedback on drag. Spring-back below threshold. Exit animation on swipe.

User Story: As a student, I want to rate my recall quality after each flashcard, so that spaced repetition schedules reviews optimally
Expected Behaviour: QualityPicker overlay after swipe. 6 quality levels (3 correct/3 incorrect). Auto-advances after 1.5s. Undo support. mode='sm2'.

User Story: As a student, I want to tap a card to reveal the answer, so that I can test my memory before swiping
Expected Behaviour: SwipeableCard supports tap-to-flip animation. Front shows question, back shows answer.

User Story: As a student, I want to browse all my flashcards, so that I can manage my collection
Expected Behaviour: FlashcardBrowseClient lists all flashcards. Search/filter functionality.

User Story: As a student, I want to create my own flashcard, so that I can study custom content
Expected Behaviour: FlashcardCreator form: front text, back text, topic, subject selector. Saves to Dexie flashcards table.

User Story: As a student, I want to share my flashcard deck with others, so that we can study together
Expected Behaviour: shareFlashcardDeck function generates share link. POST to /api/share/deck.

User Story: As a student, I want to browse available subjects, so that I can choose what to study
Expected Behaviour: StudyBrowserClient lists subjects. Each subject expandable to show topics.

User Story: As a student, I want to view detailed content for a topic, so that I can study the material
Expected Behaviour: Deep-study page shows lesson content for the specific subject/topic/subtopic hierarchy.

User Story: As a student, I want to generate a study plan based on my competency gaps, so that I can schedule my revision
Expected Behaviour: StudyPlanner shows Generate Plan button with inline form (target APS, daily minutes). Uses round-robin inverse-competency-weighted scheduling. Generates StudySession[] persisted to Dexie studyPlans.

User Story: As a student, I want to view my study plan as a calendar, so that I can see my schedule at a glance
Expected Behaviour: Month grid with session dots. Native drag-to-reschedule support.

User Story: As a student, I want to generate an AI-powered study guide for any topic, so that I can get structured review material
Expected Behaviour: SubjectSelect + topic Input. POST /api/engine/study-guide. Returns sections with content + keyPoints + summary. Animated section entrance. 'Practice these topics' + 'Generate flashcards' buttons on result.

User Story: As a student, I want to type a question and get an AI-generated solution, so that I can understand problems I'm stuck on
Expected Behaviour: AiSolver component with text input. Calls POST /api/solve. Shows step-by-step solution with solver-result-view.

User Story: As a student, I want to take a photo of a homework question, so that I can get it solved without typing
Expected Behaviour: SnapFab floating button opens snap-dialog. Camera capture via getUserMedia. OCR extraction via tesseract.js or API.

User Story: As a student, I want to see web sources used by the AI solver, so that I can verify the answer
Expected Behaviour: VerifiedByPill collapsible component in solver-result-view. Shows CheckmarkCircle01Icon + ArrowDown01Icon + LinkSquare01Icon. Hidden when sources empty.

User Story: As a student, I want to ask follow-up questions on a solution, so that I can clarify doubts
Expected Behaviour: Follow-up input below solution. Skips RAG for follow-ups (followUp===true check).

User Story: As a student, I want to chat with an AI study assistant, so that I can get help with my studies
Expected Behaviour: ChatPage renders chat UI with MessageBubble, ChatInput, WelcomeState. useChat hook manages message history. Messages scroll smoothly.

User Story: As a student, I want to send images in chat, so that I can ask about visual problems
Expected Behaviour: useImageChatWithSend hook handles image processing. ChatInput has image upload button. Shows processing state.

User Story: As a student, I want the AI to know my progress and suggest relevant content, so that chat is personalised
Expected Behaviour: chat.hasContext flag determines if context badge shown (StarsIcon 'Personalised to your progress').

User Story: As a student, I want to search across all my content (questions, wrong answers, flashcards, notes), so that I can find anything quickly
Expected Behaviour: SearchClient renders SearchWidget + SearchResults. Uses chunked-search: parallel Dexie queries with 500ms timeout. Results scored by relevance (exact > prefix > substring), max 50.

User Story: As a student, I want to view all my bookmarked questions, so that I can review them later
Expected Behaviour: BookmarksClient reads from Dexie bookmarks table. Displays list with subject/topic filters.

User Story: As a student, I want to review my wrong answers with filters, so that I can learn from my mistakes
Expected Behaviour: ReviewClient shows wrong answer journal. Subject/topic filters. Error type categorization (6 types). Each entry shows question, user answer, correct answer.

User Story: As a student, I want to practice topics I got wrong, so that I can improve
Expected Behaviour: 'Practice these topics' button links to /quiz with subject + topic params from wrong answer entry.

User Story: As a student, I want to browse a library of practice problems, so that I can find problems to work on
Expected Behaviour: ProblemsClient shows login gate if unauthenticated (LockIcon + Create Account/Sign In buttons). When authenticated: lists curated problems with step-by-step solutions.

User Story: As a student, I want to browse stories by language/subject, so that I can practice reading comprehension
Expected Behaviour: StoriesClient lists stories in grid layout (responsive: 1/2/3 columns).

User Story: As a student, I want to read a story with comprehension questions, so that I can practice reading skills
Expected Behaviour: Story reader page renders story content + follow-up questions. Progress tracked via storyProgress table.

User Story: As a student, I want to practice pronunciation with speech recognition feedback, so that I can improve my speaking
Expected Behaviour: PronunciationClient uses Web Speech API (SpeechRecognition). Shows word/phrase. Listens to user speech. Provides correctness feedback.

User Story: As a student, I want to look up word definitions, so that I can understand unfamiliar terms
Expected Behaviour: DictionaryClient provides search input. Fetches definitions. Shows pronunciation, example, save-to-vocabulary option.

User Story: As a student, I want to save words to my vocabulary list, so that I can review them later
Expected Behaviour: Save button on each definition entry. Persists to Dexie.

User Story: As a student, I want to browse study groups, so that I can find groups to join
Expected Behaviour: StudyGroupsList shows list of available groups. Each group card shows name, member count, description.

User Story: As a student, I want to view a study group and see posts, so that I can participate in the group
Expected Behaviour: Group detail page shows posts feed. Post creation input. Each post has comment/reaction capabilities.

User Story: As a student, I want to comment on a study group post, so that I can discuss with peers
Expected Behaviour: Comment input under each post. POST /api/study-groups/posts/[postId]/comments.

User Story: As a student, I want to react to a study group post (like/helpful/etc), so that I can show appreciation
Expected Behaviour: Reaction buttons on posts. Emoji reactions. Tracks via useGroupReactions hook.

User Story: As a student, I want to see the group leaderboard, so that I can see how groups rank
Expected Behaviour: LeaderboardPage fetches /api/study-groups/leaderboard. Renders ranked list with medal icons for top 3. Links to group detail. Auto-refreshes every 60s.

User Story: As a student, I want to join a live study session, so that I can study in real-time with my group
Expected Behaviour: LiveSessionBar component. 15s polling via useLiveSession hook. Appwrite-based real-time.

User Story: As a teacher, I want to see my class overview, so that I can manage my students
Expected Behaviour: TeacherDashboardClient shows class summary, recent assignments, student list.

User Story: As a teacher, I want to view a student's detailed report, so that I can assess their progress
Expected Behaviour: Fetches from GET /api/teacher/students/[studentId]/report. Shows actual student data across devices (Appwrite-backed).

User Story: As a teacher, I want to create assignments for my students, so that I can assess their understanding
Expected Behaviour: Assignment creation form with subject, topic, question count, deadline. POST /api/assignments.

User Story: As a teacher, I want to auto-grade student submissions and add comments, so that I can provide feedback
Expected Behaviour: POST /api/assignments/[id]/submit for auto-grade. Teacher comment API for manual feedback.

User Story: As a teacher, I want to record observations about students, so that I can track non-academic progress
Expected Behaviour: ObservationTimeline component. Persisted to Dexie teacherObservations (v30).

User Story: As a teacher, I want to generate ghost links to share student dashboards, so that parents can see progress
Expected Behaviour: Ghost link generation UI. POST /api/teacher/ghost-link. 30-day expiry. Ghost dashboard at /ghost/[token].

User Story: As a teacher, I want to share an assignment via link, so that students can access it
Expected Behaviour: Share link with 7-day expiry. POST /api/teacher/share-assignment. Public view at /shared/assignment/[shareId].

User Story: As a teacher, I want to send a weekly digest notification to parents, so that they stay informed about student progress
Expected Behaviour: POST /api/cron/weekly-digest (admin-protected). Computes total quizzes, avg score, top 3 subjects. Sends web push to all subscribers via web-push.

User Story: As a parent, I want to see my child's study progress, so that I can monitor their learning
Expected Behaviour: ParentDashboardPage uses RoleGate. Shows children list. ChildSelector dropdown. ChildProgressGrid with per-subject scores. ActivityTimeline. WeeklyReportPanel.

User Story: As a parent, I want to grant/revoke access to my child's data, so that I control privacy
Expected Behaviour: ConsentGate component shows consent status. Grant/revoke via POST/DELETE /api/parent/consent. ConsentMutation updates accordingly.

User Story: As a parent, I want to link my child's account to mine, so that I can view their progress
Expected Behaviour: ParentInvitationDialog sends invitation. On send: calls POST /api/parent/consent. Shows instructions for child to share User ID.

User Story: As a parent, I want to see a weekly report of my child's study activity, so that I can track trends
Expected Behaviour: WeeklyReportPanel shows subjects, total minutes, quizzes completed, streak days. Subject scores derived from actual data (not hash-based random).

User Story: As a user, I want to edit my profile (name/email/password), so that I can keep my account up to date
Expected Behaviour: SettingsClient with profile tab. Name/email/password edit forms.

User Story: As a user, I want to manage my notification preferences, so that I control what I receive
Expected Behaviour: Notification settings tab. Toggles for daily digest, push notifications, in-app notifications.

User Story: As a user, I want to switch between light and dark mode, so that I can study comfortably
Expected Behaviour: Theme toggle switch. ThemeProvider syncs theme-color meta tag dynamically. Reads resolved --system-background via getComputedStyle.

User Story: As a user, I want to change the app language, so that I can use Lumni in my preferred language
Expected Behaviour: Locale switcher in settings. Supports en, af (Afrikaans), zu (Zulu). i18n checked via scripts/check-translations.ts.

User Story: As a user, I want to control data sharing for AI features, so that I can protect my privacy
Expected Behaviour: Consent toggle in Data tab. Reused by consent/ai-gate.ts for RAG and TinyFish features.

User Story: As a user, I want to export my study progress data, so that I can keep a personal record
Expected Behaviour: Export button generates HTML/CSS export. Progress export component.

User Story: As a user, I want to restart the onboarding wizard, so that I can re-set my preferences
Expected Behaviour: Restart button in Settings > Data tab. Clears onboarding state from Dexie.

User Story: As a screen reader user, I want settings tabs to use proper ARIA tab pattern, so that navigation is accessible
Expected Behaviour: SettingsClient uses role='tabpanel', aria-labelledby, aria-controls for tab panels.

User Story: As a user, I want to learn about premium features, so that I can decide whether to upgrade
Expected Behaviour: PremiumClient shows feature comparison. All features are free (premium gating removed). Page describes available features.

User Story: As a user, I want to access support channels, so that I can get help when I need it
Expected Behaviour: SupportPage lists 3 channels: Email (mailto:support@lumni.app), In-App Chat (/chat), Knowledge Base (https://help.lumni.app). Each with icon + priority description.

User Story: As a user, I want to read the Terms of Service, so that I understand the rules
Expected Behaviour: Static terms page.

User Story: As a user, I want to read the Privacy Policy, so that I understand how my data is handled
Expected Behaviour: Static privacy page.

User Story: As a user, I want to read the Cookie Policy, so that I understand cookie usage
Expected Behaviour: Static cookie policy page. Cookie banner on first visit.

User Story: As anyone with a link, I want to view a shared question, so that I can see and rate the question
Expected Behaviour: SharedQuestionClient shows question text + answer with 5-star gating. VerifiedByPill for sources. View counting.

User Story: As a student, I want to view a shared assignment, so that I can access teacher-assigned work
Expected Behaviour: Shared assignment page. Reads from sharedQuestions Dexie table. Shows assignment details and questions.

User Story: As anyone with a link, I want to view a shared flashcard deck, so that I can study shared cards
Expected Behaviour: Shared deck page. Shows flashcard deck with read-only cards.

User Story: As a parent/teacher with a token, I want to view a temporary student dashboard, so that I can see progress
Expected Behaviour: Ghost dashboard reads student data via Appwrite query. 30-day expiry.

User Story: As a student without internet, I want to see what's available offline, so that I can keep studying
Expected Behaviour: OfflinePage shows offline status indicator, quick actions (Practice Offline, Review Flashcards), recently read stories, available quiz packs.

User Story: As a student, I want to manage downloaded offline quiz packs, so that I can study without internet
Expected Behaviour: OfflinePackManager in dashboard. Subject selector. Pack list with status badges (generating/ready/error). Storage progress bar. Uses QuizPackService + Dexie quizPacks/packQuestions tables.

User Story: As a student without internet, I want to read cached stories, so that I can continue reading offline
Expected Behaviour: storyCache Dexie table stores story content. Offline page shows recently read story titles with links to /stories/[id].

User Story: As an admin, I want to see an overview of system stats, so that I can monitor the platform
Expected Behaviour: Admin dashboard page with summary cards.

User Story: As an admin, I want to view analytics charts and trends, so that I can understand usage patterns
Expected Behaviour: Analytics dashboard with charts (DAU/WAU from analyticsEvents Dexie table). Cost summary chart per-LLM-provider.

User Story: As an admin, I want to manage users, so that I can handle accounts
Expected Behaviour: User list with search/filter. Ban/delete/role-change actions.

User Story: As an admin, I want to moderate questions, so that I can ensure quality
Expected Behaviour: Question list with filters. Editable fields. Delete option.

User Story: As an admin, I want to see question quality ratings, so that I can assess content quality
Expected Behaviour: QuestionRatingsDashboard with bar chart (1-5 star distribution). Dynamically imported BarChartComponent.

User Story: As an admin, I want to manage content items, so that I can curate the platform
Expected Behaviour: Content management interface. CRUD operations for educational content.

User Story: As an admin, I want to see AI cost tracking, so that I can manage the budget
Expected Behaviour: Budget dashboard with per-provider cost config and estimatedCost in AILatencyRecord. Cost summary chart.

User Story: As an admin, I want to send notifications to users, so that I can communicate updates
Expected Behaviour: Notification sending interface. Target by user/group/all.

User Story: As an admin, I want to view system observability data, so that I can monitor health
Expected Behaviour: Observability dashboard with AI latency records, error rates, job queue status. analyticsEvents table tracking.

User Story: As an admin, I want to manage past exam papers, so that I can curate the exam library
Expected Behaviour: Past paper management. CRUD for exam papers. Upload new papers.

User Story: As an admin, I want to manage gamification settings, so that I can adjust rewards
Expected Behaviour: Gamification settings dashboard. Modify XP multipliers, achievement criteria.

User Story: As an admin, I want to backfill question embeddings, so that semantic search works for all questions
Expected Behaviour: Embed backfill page with progress indicator. Triggers script to generate embeddings for all questions.

User Story: As a developer, I want to test the question engine (generate/grade/hint), so that I can validate the API
Expected Behaviour: DevEnginePage with form fields (subject, topic, count, questionType). Generate button calls POST /api/engine/generate. Shows raw JSON response. Test Grade button per question calls POST /api/engine/grade.

User Story: As a developer, I want to test the visual engine, so that I can see diagram generation
Expected Behaviour: Visual engine test page generating diagrams for questions.

User Story: As a developer, I want to see all test routes, so that I can quickly navigate to dev tools
Expected Behaviour: List of links to all dev/testing pages.

User Story: As a user on desktop, I want a categorized sidebar navigation, so that I can quickly access any area
Expected Behaviour: DesktopSidebar shows categorized nav (Study, Practice, Tools, Social, Account categories). Page search/filter input. SidebarStateProvider for open/close. SidebarHamburger.

User Story: As a user on mobile, I want bottom navigation tabs, so that I can easily navigate one-handed
Expected Behaviour: BottomNav shows icon tabs for key routes. Active state highlight.

User Story: As a user, I want to click my avatar to access account options, so that I can manage my profile
Expected Behaviour: Avatar dropdown menu with profile, settings, sign out. Menu uses React state + useEffect close-on-navigate. border border-border for visibility in dark mode.

User Story: As a user, I want the app to respect my system dark mode preference and allow manual toggle, so that I study comfortably
Expected Behaviour: ThemeProvider syncs theme-color meta tag dynamically. Uses getComputedStyle for --system-background. SSR viewport with light/dark media query.

User Story: As a user, I want a distraction-free full-screen mode for focused study, so that I can concentrate
Expected Behaviour: ImmersiveModeProvider context. useImmersiveMode hook. TopNav, BottomNav, DesktopSidebar return null when isImmersive. Exit button pill top-right.

User Story: As a user, I want smooth page transitions, so that navigation feels fluid
Expected Behaviour: useNavigationDirection owns full lifecycle with startViewTransition wrapper. ViewTransition component for shared element animations.

User Story: As a user, I want to install Lumni as a PWA, so that I can use it like a native app
Expected Behaviour: Service worker (public/sw.js) with navigation preload + offline fallback. Manifest theme_color. pwa_install + offline_visit event tracking.

User Story: As a student, I want mathematical equations rendered correctly, so that I can read formula-based content
Expected Behaviour: MarkdownRenderer uses remark-math + rehype-katex. Equation component for standalone math. Dollar-sign delimiters ($ for inline, $$ for display).

User Story: As a user, I want to see loading skeletons while content loads, so that I know the app is working
Expected Behaviour: PageSkeleton, FormSkeleton, QuestionCardSkeleton, Skeleton components used across all pages. Suspense boundaries with fallbacks.

User Story: As a user, I want to see a graceful error UI when something crashes, so that I'm not left with a blank screen
Expected Behaviour: AppErrorBoundary wraps page content. Shows error state with retry option.

User Story: As a user, I want to receive push notifications for important events, so that I stay informed
Expected Behaviour: notification-service.ts with permission + subscribe + local notifications. VAPID-based web push. Wired to onboarding step 4. scheduleDailyDigest for daily summary.

User Story: As a visitor, I want to be informed about cookie usage and consent, so that I can make a choice
Expected Behaviour: Cookie banner on first visit. Accept/Decline buttons. Consent persisted to Dexie/Datasharing consent.

User Story: As a user, I want to use the app in English/Afrikaans/isiZulu, so that I can study in my preferred language
Expected Behaviour: next-intl integration. [locale] routing. Translation files for en, af, zu. Scripts for checking and translating.
